scope: All 341 canonical components, including every absent/partial/deferred row. Legacy source status is not final product acceptance.

phases.title: Inventory, requirements and completion gates
phases.exitCriteria: Map all 341 IDs once; preserve baseline evidence; validate phase dependencies and mandatory completion gates.

phases.title: Native runtime bootstrap
phases.exitCriteria: Start the canonical generated factory in the native consumer; exercise seven engines, snapshots and Cadence edits through actual JS/native calls; verify cleanup and errors on iOS/Android.

phases.title: Shared platform and document infrastructure
phases.exitCriteria: Complete task/cancellation/cache/binary APIs, autosave/recovery, atomic gesture transactions, collaboration, file/share, keyboard and accessibility infrastructure.

phases.title: Decoder and playback foundation
phases.exitCriteria: Implement real Android/iOS/web media decoding, native video playback and frame-accurate seek; validate cancellation, bounds, codec failures and lifecycle.

phases.title: Studio shell and advanced GUI foundations
phases.exitCriteria: Complete all shell controls, commands, bounded unit inputs, real import/export delivery, overlay coordination, clipboard/drag-drop and workspace/document continuity.

phases.title: Canvas, selection, layers and vectors
phases.exitCriteria: Complete real rendering, transforms, selection, masks, crop/encode, artboards and vector operations with atomic undo and stable document snapshots.

phases.title: Brush, ink, pen and timelapse
phases.exitCriteria: Implement brush/dynamics/taper/stabilization, pixel/vector/mask erasing, hardware input/prediction/Muse integration and actual timelapse encoding.

phases.title: Color and image processing
phases.exitCriteria: Complete color spaces/gamut/ICC/proof, swatches/gradients/mesh, histograms/curves/grading/scopes and actual eyedropper sampling.

phases.title: Timeline and video production
phases.exitCriteria: Complete every remaining timeline/video component against real decoded media, effect rendering, tracking/stabilization/captions, cache and encoded export.

phases.title: Audio, MIDI and recording
phases.exitCriteria: Complete real playback/recording/device routing, automation/comping, MIDI/sequencer, latency/surround, offline DSP/model-backed features and valid exported audio.

phases.title: Photo catalog and RAW development
phases.exitCriteria: Implement catalog/version metadata and genuine RAW/develop/lens/mask/retouch/batch-export processing; select and verify missing decoding/processing dependencies first.

phases.title: Motion and compositing
phases.exitCriteria: Implement composition state, keyframes/easing/graphs/paths, 3D/cameras/lights, mattes/effects, bounded expressions, particles, nodes and rendering queues.

phases.title: Documents and typography
phases.exitCriteria: Complete Quill layout/caret/IME/fonts, styles/tables/page layout/review/TOC/citations/mail merge and actual speech/dictation workflows.

phases.title: Spreadsheet completion
phases.exitCriteria: Complete every Tally grid/formula/format/validation/sort/chart/pivot/import/comment/view feature with real workbook state and keyboard/clipboard semantics.

phases.title: Slides and presentation
phases.exitCriteria: Complete Pitch masters/templates/canvas/diagrams/transitions/animation/morph/notes/media/charts, presenter displays, rehearsal and persistent ink.

phases.title: PDF editing and delivery
phases.exitCriteria: Complete real PDF rendering/search/selection/annotation/forms/signatures/organizing/redaction/encryption/compare/print/scan/text editing and speech attachments.

phases.title: UI design and prototyping
phases.exitCriteria: Implement authoritative design/component/layout/variable/prototype state, real preview/handoff/presence/comments and multi-slice encoding.

phases.title: CAD, 3D, materials and nodes
phases.exitCriteria: Implement actual 3D rendering, gizmos/UV/PBR/texture painting/baking/nodes, drafting/snaps/dimensions/paper space and a real parametric constraint backend.

phases.title: Desktop, XR and additional host integration
phases.exitCriteria: Complete native Windows/macOS/visionOS/Quest/PICO hosts and their component adapters, displays/input/lifecycle; finish QNX/Linux host scope and ABI/toolchain validation.

phases.title: Full component and platform acceptance
phases.exitCriteria: Audit every component against functional, error, undo/persistence, accessibility, adaptive layout, performance, licensing and platform runtime evidence. No unverified row may be counted complete.

phases.title: Distribution and final release acceptance
phases.exitCriteria: Publish all completed packages and platform artifacts, verify checksums/exports/size/native consumers/migrations, update all consuming pins and close the full 341-row acceptance ledger.
